title: The wq Programming Language
description: A runnable introduction to the core wq language.

chapters.title: Start Here
chapters.description: Run an expression and learn how examples, results, and reference docs work.

chapters.title: Values and Display
chapters.description: Recognize atoms, containers, bools, chars, strings, tags, and result display.

chapters.title: Arithmetic
chapters.description: Use numeric, matrix, and bit operations with exact arithmetic and broadcasting.

chapters.title: Binding
chapters.description: Name values, update bindings, and unpack shapes.

chapters.title: Calls, Indexing, and Postfix
chapters.description: Call functions, index containers, and apply postfix syntax.

chapters.title: Lists
chapters.description: Create, index, reshape, transpose, unpack, and mutate lists.

chapters.title: Functions
chapters.description: Create functions, name parameters, and capture nearby bindings.

chapters.title: Higher-Order Builtins
chapters.description: Transform, filter, pair, fold, and scan lists with functions.

chapters.title: Dicts
chapters.description: Use ordered tag-keyed containers and named arguments.

chapters.title: Pipes
chapters.description: Pass values through transformations, taps, and checkpoints.

chapters.title: Control Flow
chapters.description: Combine bool conditions, choose branches, repeat work, and return early.

chapters.title: Errors
chapters.description: Read diagnostics, raise errors, assert outcomes, and inspect `@t` results.

chapters.title: Debugging with wqdb
chapters.description: Pause programs, inspect bindings, step through calls, and set useful stops.

chapters.title: Modules
chapters.description: Export a value from an isolated file and import it from another file.

chapters.title: A Prime Sieve
chapters.description: Combine lists, mutation, pipes, control flow, and functions in a prime sieve.

chapters.title: Symbolic Math with CAS
chapters.description: Create and transform symbolic expressions, then evaluate them numerically.
